name: PdfCraft
description: Headless PDF workbench (PdfCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust). Opens PDFs, merges files and images into one PDF, splits, extracts, reorders, rotates, inserts and deletes pages, password-protects and unlocks, redacts, adds headers, footers, watermarks, Bates numbers, bookmarks, comments and form fields, fills and signs forms, extracts text, checks PDF/A and accessibility, renders PNG previews and saves PDF, PNG, text and Word.
instructions:
PdfCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Upload the user's PDFs (or images) to /work and open one: doc_open {"path":"/work/a.pdf"} returns its doc id and page count; an encrypted PDF needs {"password":"..."}.
2. Merge: doc_combine {"paths":["/work/a.pdf","/work/b.pdf","/work/c.pdf"]} opens the merged PDF as a new doc and returns its id (pass "out":"/work/merged.pdf" to write it straight to a file instead); images in paths become pages. Encrypted inputs take "passwords".
3. Pages (numbers are 1-based): page_rotate {"doc":1,"degrees":90,"pages":[2]}, page_delete, page_move, page_insert_file, page_extract, doc_split {"doc":1,"out_dir":"/work/parts"}. Everything else (watermark, header/footer, redact, bookmarks, forms, compress, PDF/A…) has its own tool or an engine command: command_list {"filter":"watermark"} — always pass a filter, never list all — then the tool or command_run {"id":...,"params":{...}}. Undo with edit_undo.
4. Protect: doc_protect {"doc":1,"open_password":"..."} (permissions_password with printing/changes/copy limits restricts what readers may do); it takes effect when the doc is saved. doc_unprotect removes it. Never repeat a password in your reply or in file names.
5. Check the result: doc_info shows the pages with their size and rotation; render_preview {"doc":1,"page":2} saves a PNG of the page into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it or to show it.
6. Save: doc_save {"doc":1,"path":"/work/<new name>.pdf"}; use a new file name, never overwrite the user's input. doc_export_images {"doc":1,"folder":"/work/pages"} writes PNG pages, doc_export_text plain text, doc_export_office Word (.docx).
7. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. Edits stay in memory until doc_save, and a new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with no open document, so save after each stage and reopen the file then. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: PDF to read, edit, merge, split or protect
PNG image to add as a page or place on a page
JPEG image to add as a page or place on a page
TIFF image to add as a page
GIF image to add as a page
BMP image to add as a page
Form data to import into a PDF form
Form data or comments to import into a PDF

returns.description: Edited, merged, split or password-protected PDF
render_preview of a page or exported page image
